title: Digitalis purpurea tincture for medicinal use
intro: Digitalis purpurea tincture is a preparation made from the dried leaves of the foxglove plant, which contains cardiac glycosides such as digoxin and digitoxin. It has been historically used in herbal medicine to support heart function and regulate heart rhythm. The tincture is typically diluted and used under the guidance of a trained herbalist or healthcare professional due to its potent effects. It may help in treating conditions like congestive heart failure and arrhythmias. However, it requires careful dosing to avoid toxicity.
